system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: Each analyst produces an evidence report e(r) m at round r in a template that separates verifiable observations from interpretive inferences
system_prompt_style.note: Role-specific prompts rendered with query, context and elicited knowledge; all prompts in App. G.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: it constructs modality-specific interfaces—textual context for semantics, charts for global structure, and precise numerical evidence
env_context_strategy.note: Environment is a time series: derived views injected up front plus agent-driven Lookup querying.

context_compaction.evidence_quote: For rounds r≥2 , each analyst conditions on the others’ previous evidence
context_compaction.note: No compaction mechanism described; structured evidence reports are passed between rounds.

observation_format.evidence_quote: For multimodal inputs, we provide two figures: a multi-panel time-domain plot and a multi-panel frequency-domain plot.

tool_call_format.evidence_quote: Controlled tool access to the time series and derived attributes, denoted Lookup(·), supports querying values over intervals
tool_call_format.note: Tool-call syntax not stated; inferred from API LLM tool invocation.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: reviewer agents verify temporally checkable claims via numerical lookup and code execution

protocol_standardization.evidence_quote: Controlled tool access to the time series and derived attributes, denoted Lookup(·)

loop_primitives.note: Fixed stages (elicitation, debate rounds, VCC); 3 parallel reviewers each produce a calibrated answer, synthesized -> multi_attempt.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: k encodes a characterization of the task/domain, domain constraints and expected patterns, salient signal attributes, a recommended analysis procedure
planning_granularity.note: Elicited knowledge includes a recommended procedure but is prompt text, not a maintained plan object.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote: assigns modality-specialized agents to textual context, visual patterns, and numerical signals, and coordinates their interaction through a verification-conflict-calibration procedure
multi_agent_topology.note: Fixed hand-off: analysts -> reviewers -> synthesizer; debate among peers within the analyst stage.

delegation_mechanism.evidence_quote: a final synthesizer evaluates reviewer reasoning quality and produces the final answer

human_in_loop.evidence_quote: TS-Debate is thus intended for error-sensitive, auditable offline analysis rather than high-throughput serving.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: produces a calibrated answer ˆaj and an accompanying VCC record

state_persistence.evidence_quote: Across all 5,742 stored traces, reviewer agents issued 28,741 claim verdicts

self_verification.evidence_quote: Reviewer agents check decision-critical claims with lightweight code execution and numerical lookup, resolve cross-modal disagreement, and calibrate the final answer.
self_verification.note: Reviewers score analysts and the synthesizer scores reviewers; code execution verifies arithmetic but no test suite.

retry_policy.evidence_quote: If all reviewers exhibit approach errors (ΛAPPROACH_ERROR), the synthesizer re-verifies the most decision-critical claims and derives an answer directly.

rollback.evidence_quote: TS-Debate performs no task-specific training and does not update parameters at inference time
rollback.note: Read-only analysis over a time series; no state to roll back.

termination_condition.evidence_quote: TS-Debate uses a fixed configuration with 2 analyst rounds, 3 parallel reviewers, and a final synthesizer.

cost_controls.evidence_quote: Cost is controllable along three axes.

timeouts.evidence_quote: TS-Debate requires about 71 seconds and incurs a cost of $0.033 per sample.
